name: Milagros (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally by a light blue wavy band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above and yellow below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Milagros (a wheel, a saltire and a bridge on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Milagros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
